entries.title: Confirm assembly deletion
entries.description: Deleting an assembly now requires confirmation, helping prevent accidental removal.

entries.title: Print labels for received parts
entries.description: Print labels directly from received purchase orders, with adjustable copy counts for stock currently on hand.

entries.title: Navigate job details with tabs
entries.description: Job details are now organised into tabs, and your preferred view is remembered. Activity stays scoped to the job you are viewing.

entries.title: Improve light mode visibility
entries.description: Status badges, tabs, product placeholders, and other interface elements now use clearer, consistent colours in light mode.
